endpoints.name: PTree.Interp.ITreeSourceInterp.observe_embed_before
endpoints.type:
@ITreeSourceInterp.observe_embed_before
     : forall (E F : Type -> Type) (h : forall X : Type, E X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (MN : Type -> Type) (A : Type) (t : ITreeDefinition.itree E A),
       @PTreeDefinition.observe F MN A
         (@ITreeBridge.from_itree F MN A (@ITreeSourceInterp.itree_interp_before E F h A t)) =
       match @ITreeDefinition.observe E A t with
       | @ITreeDefinition.RetF _ _ _ a =>
           @PTreeDefinition.RetF F MN A (PTreeDefinition.ptree F MN A) a
       | @ITreeDefinition.TauF _ _ _ u =>
           @PTreeDefinition.TauF F MN A (PTreeDefinition.ptree F MN A)
             (@ITreeBridge.from_itree F MN A (@ITreeSourceInterp.itree_interp_before E F h A u))
       | @ITreeDefinition.VisF _ _ _ X e k =>
           @PTreeDefinition.TauF F MN A (PTreeDefinition.ptree F MN A)
             (@ITreeBridge.from_itree F MN A
                (@ITreeDefinition.ITree.bind F X A (h X e)
                   (fun x : X => @ITreeSourceInterp.itree_interp_before E F h A (k x))))
       end
endpoints.assumptions: Closed under the global context
